text.tspan: GRU (packed IMDb classifier) | Operators & tensor flow
IMDb / embedding128 / hidden256 / one direction / packed / eval / read bottom to top
T: padded time axis; B: batch; V: realized vocabulary; E=128; H=256
lengths enter packing through a side port; recurrent weights are reused across time
nn.GRU is a library boundary; model returns logits; caller Sigmoid / threshold are outside
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
